plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Architecture documentation and diagramming skills — describe IT systems with ASCII diagrams (arch-describe) and generate draw.io XML diagrams (arch-draw).

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: PPTX tooling — two style guides for the pptx skill (corporate core-style, architecture-committee arch-style) plus pptx-compare, a diagnostic harness that diffs two decks structurally, by rendered pixels, or one slide at a time.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian vault tooling — offdesk pushes markdown from any project into an Obsidian vault on a phone or tablet and pulls annotated callouts back, over either of two transports: syncthing (P2P, the default) or icloud (an Obsidian vault in iCloud Drive, for iPad).

plugins.name: publish
plugins.description: Publish a file to a transport provider: markdown is rendered to PDF (weasyprint + IBM Plex via the pdf skill), while ready-made artifacts (.pdf/.pptx/.key/.docx) are copied verbatim (passthrough, no conversion). pdf renders MD → PDF; publish layers transport providers on top (v1.4 ships icloud, google-drive, and onedrive).
